pages.title: Not All Rot Is Waste
pages.text: Use an unusual cold drop in actual cooking and brewing.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Frostbitten supplies the material; native processing includes cooking flesh or brewing. Freeze immobilizes its target. Channeled is different: it attracts natural lightning to a player during storms.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Frozen flesh is a material; Freeze immobilizes and Channeled attracts storm lightning. These are not one generic cold effect.
